Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C (1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans - Zoning Map Amendment
1218 West George Street, Chicago, Illinois 60657

Proposed Zoning: RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District

Lot Area: 3,075 square feet

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a Type I Zoning Map Amendment, with secondary
relief for Administrative Adjustment(s) and/or Variation(s), pursuant to
Section 17-13-0300 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, in order to permit
the construction and occupancy of a new three-story (with basement)
residential building and a detached garage at the subject property. The
programming for the proposed new development calls for the establishment
of two (2) duplex dwelling units to be distributed on and between the
basement through 3° floors. A detached garage, with roof deck, will be
situated at the rear of the property, which will provide secure off-street
parking for two vehicles. The proposed improvements will be masonry in
construction, with the new principal building measuring 38 feet-0 inches in
height.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 3,690 square feet (1.2 FAR) (Total Building)
(B) The Project’s Density (Lot Area Per Dwelling Unit): 2 units (1,537.5 square feet)
(C) The amount of off-street parking: 2 automobile spaces
(@) — Setbacks: a. *Front Setback: 10 feet-8 inches

b. **Rear Setback: 2 feet-0 inches

c. Side Setbacks:
West: 2 feet-0 inches
East: 3 feet-0 inches

*In order to accommodate the provision of larger format dwelling units intended for occupancy
by growing families, as well as to provide a meaningful occupiable “backyard” that strictly
complies with the open space requirements and conforms to the character of the other residences
on this block, the Applicant is requesting a minimal reduction to the required front setback from
12 feet-5 inches to 10 feet-8 inches [Section 17-13-1101-B]. Such requested relief is necessary in
order to overcome the topographic hardship created by the substandard depth of the subject site,
which measures two feet shorter than a standard depth lot as defined by the current Zoning
Ordinance — i.e. 123 feet (subject) vs. 125 feet (standard). Keeping with these same considerations,
the building orientation and setbacks are completely compatible with the pattern of improvements
on this residential block, where the immediately adjacent properties to the west - 1222 West
George Street and 1224 West George Street, both have front setback conditions of 10 feet or less.

1

Final for Publication

** In order to accommodate connected access to the roof deck above the detached garage from
the principal building and units that comprise the same, the Applicant is seeking a reduction in
the required rear setback from 36 feet-11 inches to 2 feet-0 inches [Section 17-13-1101-B]. The
design for the proposed new rooftop access calls for an elevated “bridge” that connects to the
required open secondary ‘stair structure off of the rear of the principal building. The bridge
connection was purposefully chosen in lieu of a separate grade level parallel stair structure in an
effort to preserve the continuity and function of the rear yard open space for the shared use and
enjoyment of the residents of the building and in further conformity to the pattern of accessory
improvements on the block

(E) Building Height: 38 feet-0 inches (underside of 3" Floor ceiling beam)
